title: Project: Multi-tenant SaaS Backend
summary: Build a tenant-isolated SaaS control plane: enforced tenancy at the data layer, plans and entitlements, seat and quota accounting, and an append-only audit log.

rubric.label: Correctness
rubric.description: Every visible and hidden test passes: isolation, entitlements, quota accounting and audit ordering.

rubric.label: Architecture
rubric.description: Isolation is enforced by construction — a store that cannot be asked for another tenant's rows — rather than by remembering to add WHERE clauses at every call site.
